staged_integration.method: Disclosed test teleports and ending hook; not natural traversal
checks: Title reaches a ready, enabled state
WASD moves the embodied player through the scene
River outside the bridge blocks forward travel
Pause freezes narrative time and resumes
Sari choice uses the dialog and records a world consequence
Actual camera shutter creates and records an image
Reload and Continue restore progress, choice and captured photograph
Damar encounter advances the physical errand
Parcel causes impact and persistent aftermath with active effects
Shelter help choice opens the courtyard and preserves its branch
Non-graphic ending reaches historical afterword without posthumous notes
Notebook download contains all nine entries, captured photo and sources
Narrow viewport notebook stays within the screen
New account resets temporary state; low quality, reduced motion and Indonesian persist
No uncaught errors, console errors or failed resource requests
